misc.discord_discovery_description:
C.A.I.N. shì yígè xiūfù shèjiāo méitǐ qiànrù de Discord jīqìrén，
shǐyòng zàixiàn fúwù (rú [FxTwitter](https://github.com/FixTweet/FxTwitter))

**Jùtǐ láishuō， cǐ jīqìrén huì zìdòng jiāng shèjiāo méitǐ liànjié chóngxīn fābù wèi “xiūfù” bǎnběn
，qízhōng bāohán gènghǎo de qiànrù (lìrú， yǔnxǔ zhíjiē zài Discord zhōng bōfàng shìpín)。**

## Gōngnéng yǔ liàngdiǎn

- Zhīchí Twitter, Nitter, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky, Snapchat, Facebook,
  Pixiv, Twitch, Spotify, DeviantArt, Newgrounds, Mastodon, Tumblr, BiliBili, Pinterest, IFunny, YouTube, Imgur,
  Weibo, Fur Affinity, Rule34.xxx, Danbooru, Gelbooru, e621, e926, Realbooru, Hypnohub, Konachan, Yande.re,
  Derpibooru, Rule34.paheal, XBooru, TBIB， yǐjí nín xuǎnzé de rènhé zìdìngyì wǎngzhàn
- Tiězi fānyì
- Kě àn wǎngzhàn、 píndào、 chéngyuán、 juésè huò guānjiànzì jìnyòng
- Gāodù kězìdìngyì de xíngwéi hé wàiguān
- Zhīchí duōzhǒng yǔyán
- Xiàndàihuà de shèzhì jièmiàn
- Kě xiǎngyìng jīqìrén hé Webhooks
- Zūnzhòng Markdown yǔfǎ
- Zūnzhòng yǐnsī
- Yuándàimǎ gōngkāi

## Shǐyòng fāngfǎ

Zhǐxū fāsòng bāohán jiānróng shèjiāo méitǐ liànjié de xiāoxi， jīqìrén jiāng yíchú yuányǒu de qiànrù（rúguǒ yǒu）bìng
zìdòng jiāng qí zuòwéi “xiūfù” liànjié chóngxīn fābù。

Nín yě kěyǐ tōngguò zài xiāoxi zhōng tiānjiā "fxignore" lái hūlüè liànjié： pǔtōng de qiànrù jiāng bǎochí yuányàng。

Nín kěyǐ shǐyòng `/settings` mìnglìng guǎnlǐ jīqìrén de shèzhì。

Zuìhòu， nín kěyǐ suíshí shǐyòng `/about` mìnglìng huòqǔ yǒuguān jīqìrén de gèngduō xìnxī bìng xúnqiú bāngzhù。
